name: Percival 'Percy' Swinetooth

greeting: Shhh! The sauce is reducing! One wrong move and it's ruined!
You're early! Or late! Time is an illusion in the kitchen!
Percy the Purple, culinary genius! That's what the menu says, and the menu never lies!
Have you ever tasted true perfection? No? Good. Keeps you humble.
The kitchen is my domain! Enter at your own peril! And appetite!
Ingredients speak to me. Mostly they say 'cook me,' but sometimes... darker things.
A true chef never reveals his secrets! But I might. For a price. Or a really good mushroom.
Food is art! Art that you eat! And sometimes regret!
dialog.secret_recipe: My secret sauce? Ha! Passed down through seventeen generations of Swinetooths! It requires... ingredients. Rare ingredients. From places you wouldn't believe.
dialog.kitchen_rules: Rule one: Don't touch my knives. Rule two: Don't touch my sauces. Rule three: Especially don't touch the purple sauce. That's for... special occasions.
dialog.backstory: I trained under the Grand Chef of the Crystal Spire. Exiled for 'creative differences.' They said my mushroom soufflé was 'too alive.' As if that's a bad thing! The Mire appreciates true art.
rumors: The foodboys on the boardwalk? Amateurs! Their hot sauce is just... hot. No nuance! No artistry!
I hear the barrelgob knows where to find truffles. Real truffles. The kind that whisper.
The onionbosses' dispute? Started over lunch, I bet. Bad food makes bad tempers.
Someone told me the luchador fighter eats nothing but raw eggs. Barbaric. Delicious, but barbaric.
ambient_barks: The secret ingredient is... love! And arsenic! Kidding! Mostly!

time_of_day.morning: Breakfast! The most important meal! Mine's experimental porridge. Results vary!
time_of_day.noon: Lunch is serious business. I take it very seriously. You should too.
time_of_day.evening: Dinner service! The chaos! The drama! The DELICIOUSNESS!
time_of_day.night: Late night is when I experiment. The kitchen is quiet. The ingredients... suggestible.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: My secret sauce needs one final component. Whispercap mushrooms. Only grow in the Echo Caverns, and nobody goes there because of the... echoes. But for true culinary perfection, I must have them!
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Whispercap mushrooms. White caps, blue gills, faint humming sound. Three should do it. Don't eat them raw. Trust me.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: The caverns give up their treasures grudgingly, eh? Keep looking! The sauce depends on it!
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: THE WHISPERCAPS! Listen to them hum! Perfect! Here - taste the sauce now. This is culinary divinity! And here's a little something for your trouble.

party_reactions.kade: His food is... actually really good. Weird, but good.
party_reactions.nix7: Culinary analysis: 40% probability of edible outcome. 60% probability of gastric distress. Worth it?
party_reactions.twist: He said I could lick the bowl! BEST DAY EVER!
party_reactions.korr: A warrior respects any who masters their craft. This one has mastered... something.
party_reactions.renna: There's actual magic in that kitchen. Subtle, but there. He doesn't even know he's doing it.
party_reactions.suresh: The purple sauce... I recognize that flavor. Old magic. Dangerous, but delicious.
party_reactions.sova: Food's food. As long as it fills the gut, I don't ask questions.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of my old cook. Crazy as a loon, but could make shoe leather taste like steak.
party_reactions.ashka: The kitchen is a fire hazard. I offered to help. He said I 'lacked subtlety.'
party_reactions.senna: He knows things he shouldn't. The mushrooms tell him secrets.
party_reactions.callum: I tried the 'surprise stew.' I'm still not sure what surprised me more - the taste or the texture.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New customer! Try the daily special! It's always a surprise! Literally - I decide when you order!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more! You have adventurous taste buds! I respect that!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite diner! I have something special planned for you today! Don't ask what!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You... you actually appreciate my art. The others just eat. You UNDERSTAND. Here. The real secret recipe. Guard it well.

cross_npc_connections: pigman_brown: Gristle! My business partner! He handles the money, I handle the magic!
foodboys_red: That hot sauce vendor thinks he knows heat! I'll show him heat! One day!
barrelgob_green: The goblin claims to know where rare ingredients grow. Might be worth pursuing.
